_about: Known rocket stacks for the game test sandbox. setup.mjs --rocket <name> --at <slug> builds one through the admin game editor (give_card, flip_card, set_water, teleport). Only mark verified after the planner accepted a route AND the server executed the MOVE with this exact stack; record where and when. `active` is the thruster switched on with SET_ACTIVE_THRUSTER: a stack without an active thruster has net thrust 0 and can only coast zero-burn legs.

plasmoid.note: Pulsed Plasmoid: thrust 3, fuel 1, no supports. Small tank on purpose: 30 water drops net thrust to 0.
plasmoid.verified: 2026-11-14: LEO to Didymos (2 burns, 2 fuel steps) and Saturn hazard coasts; server MOVE ok
